record.name: Niger
record.summary: No qualifying institute or commitment identified. A minister announced work towards an AI and data strategy in July 2025; the National Cybersecurity Centre has an information-systems security mandate.

next_check.reason: Routine re-check on a two-year rotation of states with no reported plans.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.
Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. The government account describes preparation of an AI strategy with ethical/legal and skills priorities. It does not establish a national institute to evaluate advanced models or institute-specific study. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: The recorded ha query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Indexed results were sparse or noisy; the recorded language search does not establish complete coverage. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The government reports ministry-led AI and data strategy development; the separately described cybersecurity centre secures information systems.

related_bodies.name: National Cybersecurity Centre (CNAC)
related_bodies.role: Its intended role is to coordinate information-systems and critical-infrastructure security. The Council of Ministers approved its creation and statutes in October 2025. No advanced AI model-evaluation mandate was found.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Communication and New Information Technologies
related_bodies.role: It announced the intention to develop an AI and data strategy in July 2025; the announcement names no safety or model-evaluation institute.

record.notes: Hausa results did not provide usable official AI-institute evidence; coverage is limited. Read the government report of the 29 July 2025 ministerial AI-strategy statement, published 30 July, and the Council of Ministers communiqué of 11 October 2025 approving CNAC creation and statutes. Also read https://www.gouv.ne/index.php/primature/etablissements-sous-tutelle. The strategy announcement and CNAC mandate do not identify a qualifying institute or a study of that option. The HAPDP law PDF opened without extractable text and was not relied upon for new legal claims. Nigerian results were excluded. The previous claim that no AI-specific government document was located is corrected; no qualifying status-setting event is added.
